summary.what_it_is: This repository contains Anthropic's official implementation of Agent Skills for Claude. Skills are self-contained folders with instructions and resources that teach Claude how to perform specialized tasks like document creation, data analysis, or creative work.
summary.why_trending: It is the reference implementation for the Agent Skills standard (agentskills.io) and includes production document skills that power Claude's file capabilities, a topic currently receiving significant attention in AI agent development.
summary.who_its_for: Developers and users who want to extend Claude's abilities with custom skills or learn the Agent Skills specification.
